# cubepath_ddos_firewall_rule (Resource)

Manages a firewall rule of the DDoS mitigation platform on one of your IPs: match a protocol and destination port and drop, accept, validate (FiveM, RDP, DNS, Minecraft, TLS) or rate limit per source. Up to 20 rules per IP, one per protocol and port. Rules cannot be edited, so every change replaces the rule. Import with ip_address/rule_id.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (Number) Action: 0 drop, 1 accept, 2 filter; 10-12 FiveM TCP, 15-17 FiveM UDP, 20 RDP TCP, 21 RDP UDP, 30 DNS UDP, 31 DNS TCP, 40 Minecraft Java, 50 TLS validation (TCP actions need protocol 6, UDP ones 17); 60 source rate limit in pps, 61 source rate limit in Mbps.
- `dst_port` (Number) Destination port, 0 for any.
- `ip_address` (String) One of your IP addresses.
- `protocol` (Number) IP protocol number: 0 any, 1 ICMP, 6 TCP, 17 UDP.

### Optional

- `icmp` (Number) ICMP limit per source. Only used by actions 60 (packets per second) and 61 (Mbps). Defaults to 0.
- `tcp_ack` (Number) TCP ACK limit per source. Only used by actions 60 (packets per second) and 61 (Mbps). Defaults to 0.
- `tcp_all` (Number) TCP limit per source. Only used by actions 60 (packets per second) and 61 (Mbps). Defaults to 0.
- `tcp_fin` (Number) TCP FIN limit per source. Only used by actions 60 (packets per second) and 61 (Mbps). Defaults to 0.
- `tcp_rst` (Number) TCP RST limit per source. Only used by actions 60 (packets per second) and 61 (Mbps). Defaults to 0.
- `tcp_syn` (Number) TCP SYN limit per source. Only used by actions 60 (packets per second) and 61 (Mbps). Defaults to 0.
- `tcp_synack` (Number) TCP SYN-ACK limit per source. Only used by actions 60 (packets per second) and 61 (Mbps). Defaults to 0.
- `udp` (Number) UDP limit per source. Only used by actions 60 (packets per second) and 61 (Mbps). Defaults to 0.

### Read-Only

- `action_label` (String) Name of the action.
- `id` (String) ip_address/rule_id.
- `rule_id` (Number) ID of the rule.
